The main takeaway from our work is that
genetic distance is not an invariant of the substitution process and should be estimated from the data at hand rather than assumed.
the stationarity assumption is a poor approximation for the vast majority of biological sequence alignments.
the stationarity assumption should be relaxed in the context of molecular evolution.
